profile.question: Do you have an idea, service or product to offer?
profile.intro: I develop modern, functional websites adapted to each business so you can build a professional online presence and reach more customers.
profile.aboutP1: I am the creator of <LoganWeb/> and a web developer mainly specialized in JavaScript and TypeScript.
profile.aboutP2: My goal is to turn business ideas and needs into clear, functional and easy-to-use digital solutions, always prioritizing a great user experience.
profile.techIntro: I mainly work with technologies for modern and scalable web applications.
profile.javascript: Development of dynamic and interactive features for web applications.
profile.typescript: Application development with structured, typed and maintainable code.
profile.angular: Web applications built with reusable components and scalable structures.
profile.react: Development of dynamic interfaces and reusable components.
profile.aiP1: I also use Artificial Intelligence tools in my development process to improve speed, flow and efficiency.
profile.aiP2: AI supports the development process, while architecture, implementation, review and technical decisions remain part of the work.
profile.experienceP1: Besides web development, I collaborated with Outlier for approximately one year on projects related to training and evaluating Artificial Intelligence models.
profile.experienceP2: This experience allowed me to work with code evaluation, model response analysis, data and processes aimed at improving AI systems.
